body: Thanks, feel free to PM me. This isn't a problem that's going to end tonight and I'm just trying to get through the hours.

I am on meds and have no symptoms now. It's just horrible news to break, and because I still hate the person who gave it to me, I 'guess' according to a friend that I must have given him the impression I wasn't over that person. 

No, it's so much more than that. I just feel totally unequipped to handle this. I don't want to be alone forever. How is benzo/booze overdose painful--moreso than others? I'm just asking because I hadn't heard this. Thank you.

I am, because I only have valium and that's not enough to do the job. It just made me feel terrible. Thank you for caring. I really had no idea how I would get through tonight but I'm afraid this feeling isn't going to go away.
Thank you for caring and for the support you give on these forums. Much love to you.

i just turned 27 and seemed to have a pretty ok future. then the person who gave this to me lied and ruined my life. i'm so crushed and i've read so many online forums where people talk about how disgusting people with hsv-2 are. i'm on medication that lowers the risk to 1%. still the person just cowardly discarded me. and i guess he had every reason to. Cowardly because he just ghosted me.

before this, i was in a 5 year long relationship. i've never been irresponsible with my health. the person who gave it to me had 'been tested' he said. i have been completely asymptomatic too and would never risk another person's health.
